The exemption runs 'until such time as it is possible to replace them with qualified personnel' and each exemption ends sixty days after Civil Service Commission notification that registers of plate printer eligibles exist for the replacement, or when the Director finds the employee not physically capable. No held record shows the date of that notification or any finding for any of the twenty employees, so no first-end date is supported; the missing sources are the Civil Service Commission notification to the Director of the Bureau of Engraving and Printing and any later order or agency record.
